## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `80fb531781760a7c3d3891deeccbbafa14e67a4f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs + none

Inputs read: card #33578 (body, triage 6887492591, added scope 6887759291, claim 6897803131, claim amendment 6897818459, os-dev-report 6898336127; no earlier record on the card, no comment on the PR), PR #34049 (body, 3-file list, net diff against `main`, +67 / -17, merge base c3c0c30d), and the check-runs on this head. Nothing was built, run or re-run; the file contents at the head and on `main` were read with `git show` / `git grep` only.

Check-runs on `80fb5317` at the time of writing. Completed, success: Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · ESLint, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Test Core (2/8), Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Auto Label, filter. ⏳ Still in progress, so not a verdict yet: `Test Core (1/8)` and `Type Check · consumer gates`. Neither family reads `scripts/pm/**` self-tests (those are the Lint families above, all green); the PASS below is conditional on both ending green. The rest are skipped by the path filter.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set of the carry, narrowed — RIGHT.** `unexplainedPathsBetween` has ONE name-listing helper (`names`) and both reads go through it: the head-to-head list and the own delta at each head. It now sends `[...CARRY_DIFF_ARGV, a, b]` = `diff -z --name-only --no-renames A B`. A rename is listed as delete + add, so the source path reaches arm ⓪ (prose), ① (`merge=os-regen`) and ② (own delta) like any path. Direction is refusing only: every list is a superset of what it was, so no hop that was refused is now carried; hops that renamed a reviewed file out of its face are now refused. That is the card's "what lands". (verify a: holds.)
- **No sibling left — RIGHT.** At the head, `git grep` over `scripts/pm` for `--name-only` / `--name-status` without `--no-renames` finds no other carry read: the remaining hits are prose, `ls-tree`, `os-regen-merge.sh` conflict listings, the dispatch-gates derivation-surface read and self-test controls that measure the destination-only blind spot on purpose (`record-recognisers.mjs` L2901, queue guard L6165). `regenCarry` (L533) is the one production caller.
- **The pins — RIGHT.** (verify b) The regen battery's fake git returns no paths unless argv is exactly the four words plus two revisions, so a diff sent by a call site that drops the flag reds every case that expects a moved path. Three literal pins spell the flag independently of the constant (L2861, L2877, and the new L2882 that requires EVERY `diff` seen to match `diff -z --name-only --no-renames A B`), and the real-git row measures both halves in one temporary repository: a rename-detecting diff lists `content/docs/security.md` alone, and the reader returns `skills/a/rules/security.md`. Traced by hand: the docs path is dropped by arm ⓪, the source path has no `os-regen` attribute, `merge-base main` of the new head is the old head, and the own delta names the source path, so it is unexplained; without the flag `moved` is empty and the row returns `[]`. The dev's ablation (4 of 402 red) agrees, and `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` are green on this head. Battery floor 22 to 24 matches the two added `t(` rows.
- **Queue guard fake (one line) — RIGHT, forced, no verdict logic.** (verify c) L5762 sits inside `selfTest`, in the fake `git` the regen battery passes in. It read the revisions by position 3 and 4; with a five-word prefix it must read them from the tail. The guard's production code is untouched. Inside amendment 6897818459 item 1.
- **check-governed-merges fixtures — RIGHT, hygiene, no verdict logic.** (verify c) Every hunk is inside `selfTest` (L6911 onward) and changes only the `env` option of a fixture's own `git` spawn: seven helpers gain `env: gitFreeEnv()`, three backdated-commit spawns replace `...process.env` with `...gitFreeEnv()` under their two `GIT_*_DATE` keys (the keys are set after the strip, so the backdating survives). `gitFreeEnv` was already imported (L1114) and only deletes `GIT_`-prefixed keys. No assertion, no production reader (`L3473`, `L3949`) and no CLI spawn changed. Inside amendment item 2 and card comment 6887759291. After this, every `execFileSync('git'` in the self-test carries a `GIT_*`-free env.
- **Public surface — unchanged, RIGHT.** (verify e) `CARRY_DIFF_ARGV` is module-private at the head. It was exported only in the intermediate commit a5ed4548 and never on `main`; `git grep` at the head finds it in `record-recognisers.mjs` alone, so no importer exists or is broken. The header export list is byte-identical to the base, and the `dispatch-gates: self-test-reads` marker is on L77 at the head, where the census pins it. `unexplainedPathsBetween` keeps its signature. New top-level imports (`execFileSync`, `node:fs` writers, `node:os`, `node:path`, `../git-env.mjs`) are self-test only; the guard workflow's sparse checkout takes all of `scripts`, and the queue guard already imports `../git-env.mjs`, so no reader loses a file.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: all three paths are `scripts/pm/**`, repository tooling that no package publishes; `Check Changeset` is green on the head. `Clause-②: no` is right and matches the card, the claim and the PR body: no published schema, no product default, no authorable key; the one behaviour change is a review-gate carry test refusing more. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviation 1 (surface widened by amendment 6897818459, asked before editing) — ANSWERED, accepted.** The diff stays inside both added items: one fake-git line in the queue guard, fixture `env` options in check-governed-merges. Nothing else in either file moved.
- **Deviation 2 (the argv-root `git init` and `remote add` get `gitFreeEnv` and no `-c commit.gpgsign=false`) — ANSWERED, the dev is right.** (verify d) Neither command creates a commit or a tag, so no signing can be attempted; `commit.gpgsign` is read by commit-creating commands only. The amendment's "plus gpgsign" wording is met in substance: every fixture that commits already carried the flag.
- **`open_questions`: empty — nothing to answer.**
- **`out_of_scope_findings` (the self-test's own CLI children run with `process.env`-based environments and run real git in the fixture roots; noted, not filed) — ESCALATED to the seat.** The dev stayed inside the amendment, which is correct. The residue is real, though narrower than the fixed one: the children run with `--root` pointing at the fixture, but an inherited `GIT_DIR` still wins over `cwd`. Carrier: none today. It wants a card or a stated wontfix, not silence.
- **should-fix SF1 — this head does not merge into `main`.** `main` moved (#34029, #34022, #33982 touched two of the three files). A read-only `git merge-tree` of `main` and this head reports one content conflict, in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` at the `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` floors: `main` raised the adjacent template floor 30 to 32, this PR raised the regeneration floor 22 to 24. `check-governed-merges.mjs` auto-merges and every fixture there keeps its `gitFreeEnv`. The resolution is both numbers (24 and 32), but it is a hand resolution in a reviewed file, so it is in the own delta at the new head and this record does NOT carry: the resolved head owes a delta review. Not a defect of this diff, hence should-fix, and the verdict on this diff stands.
- nit N1: the fake git's exactness test compares argv against `CARRY_DIFF_ARGV` itself, so on its own it follows a mutation of the constant; the three literal pins and the real-git row are what catch that mutation. The comment "a dropped flag cannot ride through" is true of the battery, not of that line alone.
- nit N2: the queue guard's fake reads the tail whatever precedes it, so that battery does not pin the flag. Acceptable: the reader's owner pins it, and a second literal there would be a third copy to keep in step.

### ④ Design judgment

- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` against the card and the ruling it implements (the committed-trees test): holds. The flag is owned once, by the one helper, the jsdoc states why, and the scenario the card was filed on (a reviewed skills rule moved onto a docs face) is the real-git row verbatim. The row is hermetic: `GIT_*` stripped, system and global config off, identity, signing and `diff.renames=true` set per call, temporary directory removed in `finally`, and any thrown error is returned as the failing detail, never skipped. The code agrees with its comment.
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`: the fake agrees with the argv the reader now sends; no finding beyond N2.
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`: agrees with `GIT_ENV_ISOLATION_RULE` in `scripts/git-env.mjs` for the fixtures' own spawns; the dev's hook-shaped control (base file red under an inherited index, head green and no outside index written) is the right evidence and CI's self-test family is green.
- Findings: must-fix 0 · should-fix 1 (SF1) · nit 2 (N1, N2).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-cceg2o`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmPd7uRqHauEehGPr19`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6c6a5c9ee9bce96a50b468ebabc826e8a92ff963`
Local-runs: none
Scope: scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs + none

Delta round on record 6898489993 (PASS on `80fb5317`, should-fix SF1 and one ③ escalation). Inputs read: the card thread since that record (nothing new but the record itself), the PR body as it now stands, the merge commit `6c6a5c9e` (parents `80fb5317` and main `e71ecc1b`, a merge and no rebase), its resolution, the net diff against `main`, card #34066, and the check-runs on this head. Nothing was built, run or re-run; trees were read with `git show` / `git diff` only.

Check-runs on `6c6a5c9e`: none in progress, none failed. Success: Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · ESLint, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Test Core, Test Core (1/8), Test Core (2/8), Plan Test Core shards, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Auto Label, filter. `Check Changeset` reads skipped on this head (both runs), where it read success on `80fb5317`; skipped is not a refusal and the `skip-changeset` label is still on the PR. The two runs that were pending in the last round (`Test Core (1/8)`, `Type Check · consumer gates`) are green here. GitHub reports the PR mergeable (`clean`).

### ① Derived judgments

- **The delta against `main` is the same change — RIGHT.** The net diff at this head is +67 / -17 over the same three files, and its added and removed lines are identical, line for line, to the net diff reviewed at `80fb5317` (compared mechanically; only context and line numbers moved). Every judgment of record 6898489993 ① therefore stands unchanged: the carry's one `names` helper sends `diff -z --name-only --no-renames A B` on both reads, the fake git answers only that argv, three literal pins and the real-git row hold it, the queue guard and check-governed-merges edits are self-test fixtures with no verdict logic, and `CARRY_DIFF_ARGV` is module-private with no importer.
- **The merge resolution — RIGHT.** One conflict, in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` at `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES`. The resolved rows are this PR's regeneration floor `24` and main's template floor `32` with main's comment line kept: each side's own row, taken whole, nothing invented. Read against a re-merge of the two parents, the resolution removes only the conflict markers and each side's stale copy of the other's row. Nothing else in the merge commit differs from the automatic merge.
- **Floors against the batteries — RIGHT.** 24 matches the two rows this PR adds to the regeneration battery; 32 is main's own number from #34029, untouched. The census marker `dispatch-gates: self-test-reads` is still on L77 at this head. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` are green on the merged tree, which is the gate's own answer that both floors and the pin hold together. The dev's count (401 cases, 4 red under the flag ablation on the merged head) is consistent with main's set plus two.
- **check-governed-merges after the merge — RIGHT.** Main's #33982 moved the fixtures by several hundred lines; the file merged automatically and every fixture-owned `git` spawn in the self-test still carries its `GIT_*`-free env.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged and right: three `scripts/pm/**` paths, nothing published, `skip-changeset` on the PR, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **SF1 (the head did not merge into `main`) — CLOSED.** Main `e71ecc1b` is merged in, the one conflict is resolved to both floors as the last record said it should be, the net delta is unchanged, and GitHub reports the PR mergeable. This record is the delta review that the hand-resolved head owed.
- **The ③ escalation (the self-test's own CLI children inherit `GIT_*`; no carrier) — CLOSED.** Card #34066 is open, `domain:skills`, p3, states the defect and what lands (children built from `gitFreeEnv()`, one self-test row with a decoy `GIT_DIR`), and the PR body's acceptance note now reads `carrier: #34066`. The residue stays out of this PR, which is correct under amendment 6897818459.
- Deviations 1 and 2 and the empty `open_questions`: answered in record 6898489993, nothing new. The merge is a merge commit and not a rebase, as the body states; no new deviation.
- Nits N1 and N2 of record 6898489993 stand as nits, not reopened.
- Note for whoever lands it: main has moved again since `e71ecc1b`; GitHub still reports no conflict at the time of writing.

### ④ Design judgment

- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`: the change holds on the merged tree exactly as on `80fb5317`; the resolution agrees with both contracts it touches (each battery's floor equals its own case count).
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`: no change in this round beyond main's own content; prior judgment stands.
- Findings this round: must-fix 0 · should-fix 0 · nit 0 new (N1, N2 carried as nits).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-cceg2o`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmPd7uRqHauEehGPr19`

**VERDICT: PASS**

- **前提实测:** the carry's `names` helper listed a rename by its destination only (`diff -z --name-only` without `--no-renames`); both reads now send `--no-renames`; ablation (drop the flag) 4/401 red, restored.
- **复核:** PASS 6898489993 on `80fb5317` with one should-fix (SF1, conflict with main); delta PASS 6898774527 on this head, `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, SF1 closed (merge commit, both floors kept: regen 24, template 32), net delta line-for-line identical to the reviewed one; no must-fix, no should-fix open.
